subject: Sales→CS: LumenHealth priority acceptance & kickoff asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Customer Success Team <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <emorales@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + handoff: LumenHealth (RDW-2026-0457) — priority list and kickoff

Team — quick handoff note for LumenHealth (signed MSA yesterday; SOW in progress). High level and asks below so CS can accept and plan sprint-0 items. Happy to sync if helpful.

Deal context (short):
- Use case: inference for clinical summarization and patient Q&A in their clinician portal (read-only extracts).
- Expected go-live: pilot internal beta by 2026-10-25; public rollout early 2027.
- Committed: Dedicated capacity (2x A40 equivalent), regional requirement: us-west only, higher retention windows for logs (90 days) per procurement ask.
- Commercial: annual committed spend + onboarding professional services (SOW under the attached draft).

Priority acceptance checklist (please confirm owner):
1) Security posture & evidence: SOC2 and selected control evidence already sent — procurement asked for a tighter mapping doc (see attached security workbook). Owner: ???
2) Network & private endpoints: they require VPC peering and restricted egress to approved IPs; point person to coordinate with infra and customer networking. Owner: ???
3) Data residency & retention: logs retention 90d; redact PII at the prefix level (we recommended prefix/KV cache enabled). Need CS to validate config feasibility. Owner: ???
4) Model pinning & rollout plan: they want Redwood-verified model with quantization profile; may want short fallback plan to lower-cost variant in peak load. Owner: ???
5) Kickoff: propose initial technical kickoff week of 2026-08-30 (45–60 min). Please propose availability.

Attachments: LumenHealth_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (contains proposed scope, milestones), lumen_health_security_responses.xlsx (answers we sent; procurement expects a mapping).

Immediate asks: Laura, can you own the intake and confirm owners for 1–4 above? Karthik, flag any redlines you think should be added to the SOW (technical/ops). Grace, please be on standby for escalation (exec sponsor).

Thanks — I’ll remain in the thread for the first pass.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <emorales@lumenhealth.ai>, LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + handoff: LumenHealth (RDW-2026-0457) — priority list and kickoff

Thanks Markus — happy to take primary CS ownership. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

1) Security posture & evidence — owner: laura_bennett@redwood.com. Action: I will review lumen_health_security_responses.xlsx and produce the requested controls mapping by EOD 2026-08-21. If procurement needs additional artifacts (SysAdmin logs, rotation policy), please point me to specific items.

2) Network & private endpoints — owner: karthik_iyer@redwood.com (I will coordinate). Action: Karthik, can you confirm whether we need a dedicated peering runbook and the expected timeline for setting up the VPC peering in us-west? Also confirm allowed IPs process.

3) Data residency & retention — owner: laura_bennett@redwood.com. Action: We'll set retention policies to 90d in the sandbox and confirm no export outside us-west. Also will confirm redact-at-prefix options and document recommended cache settings.

4) Model pinning & rollout plan — owner: karthik_iyer@redwood.com. Action: Karthik, propose a pinned model + fallback variant and any guardrails (temperature, token caps). Recommend a canary traffic split for rollout.

Kickoff: I can host an initial kickoff on 2026-08-31 at 10:00 PT. Elena/Tom — does that work? If not, please suggest two windows next week.

SOW redlines: Markus — I will add two items to the SOW draft: (a) an explicit acceptance test with sample prompts and pass/fail criteria; (b) a runway for three one-week production toggle windows post-beta. Karthik, please add any operating assumptions.

Attachments I will produce: CS_onboarding_checklist_LumenHealth.xlsx (preliminary) and an internal runbook stub for VPC peering.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <emorales@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + handoff: LumenHealth (RDW-2026-0457) — priority list and kickoff

Thanks — looping in quick technical notes from infra perspective.

Network/VPC notes:
- We can support VPC peering to us-west; typical provisioning lead time 5–7 business days after signed network request. Customer must provide VPC CIDR and approved IP allowlist.
- For restricted egress, we'll provide NAT egress with an allowlist; if they need hardware firewall-level filtering we'll coordinate with infra engineers.

Model & runtime:
- Recommend pinning to redwood/gpt-optim-v2 (fp16 quantized profile) for initial pilot. Fallback: redwood/gpt-optim-std. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 48h, then 50%/50% for one week before full switch if metrics look good.
- KV/prefix caching: enabled; we'll use a 48h TTL for the pilot (adjustable).

Acceptance test suggestion (to include in SOW):
- 20 sample clinician prompts + expected categories of responses (safety/PII checks) and latency under 450ms p50 for templated prompts.

I'll prepare a short tech appendix to attach to the SOW (network checklist, model spec, acceptance test outline). ETA: 2026-08-21 close of day.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <emorales@lumenhealth.ai>, LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + handoff: LumenHealth (RDW-2026-0457) — priority list and kickoff

All — appreciate the quick ownership. Laura: thanks for picking this up; please consider me the exec escalation contact.

Action items I tracked:
- Laura: produce controls mapping + CS_onboarding_checklist by 2026-08-21.
- Karthik: tech appendix + VPC provisioning guidance by 2026-08-21.
- Markus: please share signed MSA reference and procurement contact (Tom) for any billing/attach order questions.
- Elena/Tom (LumenHealth): confirm kickoff 2026-08-31 10:00 PT or suggest alternatives.

I'll set a recurring internal sync for CS + solutions (weekly through pilot) once owners confirm.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
